Thanks Stephanie — helpful summary. A few clarifying questions before we lock owners/dates:

1) Retention windows: our clinical records retention policy requires a minimum of 6 years for adult records and 7 years for minors after majority — can Redwood support per-tenant retention policies (different buckets for PHI vs non-PHI)?

2) Audit logs: we need immutable, time-stamped logs that show user, request id, and redaction events. What is the granularity of the logs you can export and how easily can we ingest them into our SIEM?

3) Data residency: for some cohorts we need US-only storage — is that supported in the Hosted flow or will we need a Dedicated/Private deployment?

Connor — looping in Procurement (procurement@medlytics.com) for timeline/PO questions.

Happy to do the follow-up next Tue or Wed afternoon (ET).

Hi Sarah — quick technical responses to your items, happy to dig deeper on the follow-up call: 

- Per-tenant retention: yes — Redwood supports configurable retention policies at the customer (tenant) level and by dataset type. For MAP scoping we recommend:
  * PHI messages/records: configurable retention with default 7 years (we can set 6/7 buckets per your policy)
  * Non-PHI telemetry/logs: shorter default (90 days) with hot/cold tiers for longer archival

- Audit logs: exportable JSON lines that include timestamp, request_id, user_id, model_id, route, action (create/read/update/delete), and redaction flag. Exports are signed and can be delivered to S3 or pushed to your SIEM via a secure forwarder (TLS + client cert). Retention for audit logs is configurable; standard offer is 2 years; extended options up to 7 years for an additional storage/retention fee.

- Data residency: Hosted US regions (us-west/us-east) can satisfy US-only requirements. For stricter VPC/on-prem needs we have Redwood Private (customer-managed) or Dedicated options — we should mark that as a dependency in the MAP.

Dependencies/caveats:
- SOC2 artifact: we can share snapshot (attached) but final encrypted key rotation proofs require an executed NDA/contract in place for some artifacts.
- Procurement PO: ramp and onboarding timeline will be gated on PO receipt and a short security checklist completion (approx 2–3 business days for artifact handoff once PO is in).

Attachments: [Attachment: SOC2_snapshot_2026Q2.pdf]

Happy to join the technical portion of the follow-up.
